card.title: KUMAMOTO REGIMENT
card.flavorText: The 13th Infantry Regiment (Kumamoto) was attached to the 6th Infantry Brigade of the 6th Division and participated during the Second Sino-Japanese War. The regiment fought in the later stages of WWII, assigned to the Japanese Seventeenth Army, at Bougainville Island in the Solomon Islands.
